Children's books to read together

These children's books are made for reading out loud: on the couch after school, at the kitchen table, at church, or in bed before the lights go out.

Maurice Johnson writes for parents, grandparents, teachers and churches who want good stories for the children in their lives. Many of his books are Christian picture books. Others are about animals, feelings, family, the natural world and the holidays. There are also cookbooks, coloring and puzzle books, and a shelf of books for teens.

The site does not sell anything itself. Each book has its own page on Amazon, where you can see the formats, the current price and the shipping options. Pick a topic below to find books that fit your child, or search the full list.

Questions parents ask

Where can I buy Kid Story Books children's books?

Every book is sold on Amazon. Tap any Buy on Amazon button on this site and the book's own Amazon page opens in a new tab. This site does not have a cart or checkout.

Who writes the books on Kid Story Books?

Maurice Johnson writes them, and Dominion Publishing publishes them. Dominion Publishing is part of Dominion Digital Group. Maurice is a Christian author based in East Texas.

What kinds of children's books are there?

There are 220 books in six groups: 71 children's stories, 65 Christian books, 34 nature and science books, 32 cookbooks, 9 coloring and activity books and 9 books for teens.

Are the books paperback or eBook?

Most are paperback. Some titles also have other formats and some do not, so check the formats listed on each book's Amazon page before you buy.

How do I find a children's book to read to my child tonight?

Start with the bedtime stories page for calm, nighttime titles, or use the search box on the All Books page to look for a word like moon, bear or Noah.
